title: Unit 10 - Are you an outdoors person?

parts.title: Listening Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: Where will Joel and his family stay this year?
options: the hotel next to the river
the hotel in Great Woods
the hotel on top of the hill

items.question: How much do Daniella's walking boots cost on the website?
What time does the park close today?
What will they do in the afternoon?
options: build a tree house
go windsurfing
go mountain biking

items.question: Where are Dad's keys?
options: on the bag
on the ground
inside the car

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 1. Where will Joel and his family stay this year?

script.speaker: Joel
script.text: Dad, can we go to that hotel next to the river again this year?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Sorry, Joel. Your mother didn't like it very much.

script.speaker: Joel
script.text: How about that place on top of that hill? We stayed there two years ago.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's full, so <u>Mum and I found one in Great Woods</u>. I booked it last night.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 2. How much do Daniella's walking boots cost on the website?

script.speaker: Daniella
script.text: I saw some great new walking boots in town today but they were £120.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Oh, Daniella, why don't you look online? Your cousin bought some boots for £100.

script.speaker: Daniella
script.text: I looked at www.bestboots.com and <u>the cheapest ones were £130</u>.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Oh, really? Let's go and buy them from that shop in town then.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 3. What time does the park close today?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Excuse me. Do you know what time the park closes?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: The sign says it shuts at six thirty every day. Oh, except <u>Sunday when it closes at six</u>. That's today, isn't it?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Yes, that's right. What time is it now?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Five thirty – so it's nearly time to go.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 4. What will they do in the afternoon?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: That was awesome! I've never been windsurfing on this lake before.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: I come here a lot. It's great, isn't it? Do you know what we're going to do next?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: My dad said that after lunch <u>we're going to build a tree house</u>.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Cool! And tomorrow we're going mountain biking. I love being outdoors in the school holidays!

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 5. Where are Dad's keys?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I can't find my car keys. I thought I left them on that bag.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Look on the floor. Maybe you dropped them.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: They're not there. I think <u>they may still be inside the car</u>.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: I'll look ... You're right, Dad, here they are!

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question:
Samuel, we can't go fishing today – the lake's covered in ice. Shall we go for a bike ride instead? Is ten o'clock too late? Alfonso
Why did Alfonso send this message?
options: to find out if Samuel can go with him today
to ask Samuel to give him ideas for today's activities
to tell Samuel that they have to change their plan

items.question: The Adventure Park is closed this week while we add more fun activities.
options: You can't use the adventure park as they are repairing some parts of it.
When the adventure park opens again it will be even better than before.
There are other activities you can do while the adventure park is shut.

items.question:
Sara – about the forest walk. Dad says it isn't too hard for us, but he'll come anyway for the beautiful views and the fresh air! Amelia
Sara's dad will go with the girls because
options: he is worried that the walk is difficult for them.
the walk will be easy for him.
he wants to walk in the countryside.

items.question:
Park Café
Today's special offer:
Free guidebook for customers whose bill is over £20
options: You will get a guidebook if you spend enough today.
If you show your guidebook, your food will be cheaper.
You can buy guidebooks for less than usual today.

items.question:
Pedro – I called that little shop in the park. It's open between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. but it only sells snacks. Let's take a picnic. Monica
Monica thinks they should take a picnic because the shop
options: doesn't open at lunchtime.
doesn't sell much food.
isn't very big.

items.question:
KYLE RIVER
Please be careful when crossing this bridge in wet weather. DON'T RUN.
options: You might fall if it has rained.
The bridge is closed because of the rain.
This is the only place to cross the river in rainy weather.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 7
parts.instructions: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures. Write 35 words or more.

checklist.band5: All the content is relevant to the task. The candidate has described all three pictures clearly.
checklist.band3: Some content is relevant but may miss one picture or include irrelevant details.
checklist.band1: Content is mostly irrelevant or too short to assess.

checklist.band5: The story is well-organised with clear sequencing and connecting words (first, then, after that).
checklist.band3: Some attempt at organisation but the story may be hard to follow in places.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Ideas are not connected.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer: Some teenagers were walking in the countryside when they saw a farmer. He was upset because he was losing his sheep. A wall was broken and the sheep were walking into a road. The teenagers wanted to help the farmer, so some repaired the wall and the others took the sheep back into the field.
